title: Pulp template pack (pack.json), format version 1
description: The shape of a pack's manifest, as docs/template-format.md specifies it and src/core/pack.ts reads it. The validator is the last word: it also warns, without refusing, about a licence that is not in its list of open licences. Unknown fields are accepted.

name.description: Shown when importing; also the pack's folder name after install (lowercased, dashes).

license.description: SPDX identifier for the pack as a whole; templates carry their own.

type.description: Default type for the pack's templates; a template that declares its own keeps it.

sound.description: Sound variations for the pack's templates, declared once: a template that declares its own keeps it; for the rest, only variants whose files are inside the template's own folder apply.

templates.description: Folder names inside the pack, one per template.
